headline: 2-6 of 11 within 2 A across 10 seeds
method: Ten seeds, uniform settings (12 Monte Carlo runs x 3000 steps), every case, one command: node evals/redock.mjs --seeds 10. Structures are committed, so this needs no network and reruns identically.

supersededNote: The three runs under 'runs' are the earlier ad-hoc measurements, kept as history. They were made at different times with different settings and are no longer the figure of record.
finding: Nine of eleven cases move across seeds by more than the 2 A threshold that decides pass from fail: the measurement noise exceeds the decision boundary on 82% of the set.
consequence: No scoring or search change can be validated against this benchmark as configured. A small ensemble understates this: three seeds reported 4-5 and called three cases settled; ten report 2-6 with six unsettled.
nextStep: Reduce variance (more search effort per case) or widen the set, and re-measure. 1Q41 is the exception worth working on now: 0.01 A spread across ten seeds while failing by 6.8 A, so a scoring change there is visible rather than lost in noise.
